m1_measure_pairs — 2D measure1d op

• Data kinds: image → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "m1_measure_pairs", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: measure_pairs (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)
